ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 1:15 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark) pixels; surface is predominantly high-density dark pixels with sparse high-intensity focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation field across 90% of visible surface; distinct, small high-intensity circular blobs (mottling/spots) distributed laterally, with a higher spatial frequency on the right lobe distal quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes (2-10 pixels). Left lobe displays relatively uniform small peaks; right lobe features a prominent macroscopic indentation approximately 75% distal from the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted to the trailing edges, sweeping upward from the medial region to the tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 20 localized, circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white rings and spots) resembling barnacle scarring; 7-8 visible on left lobe, 12-14 visible on right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant non-uniform indentation (notch) on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal to the median line.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white pixel cluster (water splash) obscuring the fluke-to-peduncle insertion point and the base of the median notch.
